title: useDrag Hook
description: Manages the drag gesture for tabs and cluster chips: press threshold, movement tracking, ghost positioning, and drop target resolution.
signature: function useDrag(label: string, activeClusterId: string | null, translateStripIndex: (paneId: string, index: number) => number): { drag: DragState | null }
returns: { drag: DragState | null; tabHandle: (payload: DragPayload) => DragHandleProps; clusterHandle: (cluster: Cluster) => DragHandleProps; }
semantics: Returns drag state and handle factories; coordinates with drop zone registry to compute insertion points, splits, and detach targets.
